div.span:
1. Build prompt (session context)
2. Invoke Bedrock → script
3. Strip code fences
4. Execute in MicroVM sandbox
5. If fails → feed error back (max 2 retries)
6. Save session → stream final result

• Input validation on all params
• Firecracker VM isolation

• S3 public access blocked

div.span:
Frontend: Svelte 4 + Vite 5 + TypeScript
Backend: Node.js 22 + TypeScript 5
IaC: AWS SAM (CloudFormation)
LLM: Amazon Nova 2 Lite (Converse API)
Sandbox: Lambda MicroVMs (Firecracker)
State: DynamoDB (on-demand, 24h TTL)
CDN: CloudFront + S3 + ACM
